# teltonika_rms_device (Data Source)

A single device by id (`/devices/{id}`). RMS device payloads are wide and vary by model — `raw` exposes the full JSON body for anything not surfaced explicitly.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `company_id` (Number)
- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String)
- `fw_version` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `last_seen` (String)
- `latitude` (Number)
- `longitude` (Number)
- `mac` (String)
- `manufacturer` (String)
- `model` (String)
- `name` (String)
- `raw` (String) Full JSON body as returned by RMS.
- `serial` (String)
- `status` (String)
- `updated_at` (String)
